# National Machinery Stores

> Oil mill machinery manufacturer, exporter, supplier and service provider in Kadi, Mahesana district, Gujarat, India. Founded in 1998 by Iqbalhusen Chisti. Supplies oil expellers, filter presses, conveyors, refining equipment and spare parts, and erects and maintains complete edible-oil plants across 18+ Indian states and for export clients in Africa.

## Products and services
- [Mini Oil Expeller](https://nationalmachinerystores.com/products/mini-oil-expeller.html): A mini oil expeller is a compact screw press that crushes 1 to 5 tonnes of oilseed per day on a 3–15 HP drive. National Machinery Stores supplies new and refurbished mini expellers from Kadi, Gujarat, for groundnut, mustard, sesame, sunflower and coconut — sized for village-level units, farm processing and first-time mill owners.
- [High Capacity Oil Expeller](https://nationalmachinerystores.com/products/high-capacity-oil-expeller.html): A high capacity oil expeller is an industrial screw press built for continuous, 24-hour crushing of 5 to 50+ tonnes of oilseed per day on 20–75 HP drives. We supply new and inspected refurbished units with heavy-duty worm shafts, pressing barrels and precision-cut gearboxes for commercial edible-oil plants.
- [Screw Conveyor](https://nationalmachinerystores.com/products/screw-conveyor.html): A screw conveyor moves seed, oil cake, meal and powders through a trough or tube with a rotating helical flight. We build them in MS, SS 304 and SS 316, 100–450 mm in diameter and up to 10 m long, for horizontal, inclined or vertical runs between oil mill machines.
- [Conveyor Belt](https://nationalmachinerystores.com/products/conveyor-belt.html): Industrial rubber and PVC conveyor belts for oil mills and agro-processing, supplied in 300–1800 mm widths, 6–20 mm thickness and 2- to 4-ply construction. General, heat-resistant and oil-resistant grades are available, with cut-to-length and splicing service.
- [Casting Oil Filter](https://nationalmachinerystores.com/products/casting-oil-filter.html): A casting oil filter is a cast-iron filter press that clarifies crude pressed oil by forcing it through cloth-covered plates, removing suspended solids, wax and fine particles. We supply manual and hydraulic models with 320–630 mm plates and stacks of 10–60 plates for high-volume edible-oil mills.
- [Plastic Oil Filter (Hydraulic)](https://nationalmachinerystores.com/products/plastic-oil-filter-hydraulic.html): A plastic (PP) hydraulic oil filter press uses food-grade polypropylene plates closed by a hydraulic cylinder instead of a manual screw. It is about 50% lighter than a cast-iron filter, corrosion-free, and the usual choice for new oil mill plants. Plate sizes run from 320 to 630 mm.
- [Vassal Oil Neutralizer](https://nationalmachinerystores.com/products/vassal-oil-neutralizer.html): A vassal oil neutralizer is a steam-jacketed vessel that removes free fatty acids (FFA) from crude edible oil by alkali (caustic soda) neutralisation — the first step of chemical refining, before bleaching and deodorisation. We supply batch units from 100 to 5,000 litres with SS 304 wetted parts.
- [Radler Chain](https://nationalmachinerystores.com/products/radler-chain.html): A Radler (Redler) chain is the drag chain inside an en-masse conveyor: it pulls oilseed, cake, meal or grain through an enclosed trough as a solid mass, with no breakage, dust or segregation. Our hardened alloy-steel chains handle 1–30 tonnes per hour in horizontal, inclined, vertical and Z-type layouts.
- [Oil Expeller Spare Parts](https://nationalmachinerystores.com/products/oil-expeller-spare-parts.html): We stock oil expeller spare parts — worm shafts, pressing barrels, cages and liners, main shafts, bearings, gearbox parts, seals and filter cloths — compatible with all major Indian expeller brands. Stocked items are dispatched across India within 24–48 hours, with no minimum order and a 3–6 month warranty.
- [Oil Mill Machinery](https://nationalmachinerystores.com/products/oil-mill-machinery.html): Complete oil mill machinery covers every stage of an edible-oil plant: seed cleaning, conveying, expelling, filtration, storage tanks, pumps and piping. We supply individual machines or full 2–100+ TPD plant packages, new or inspected used, with installation and commissioning.
- [Oil Mill Erection & Service Contracts](https://nationalmachinerystores.com/products/oil-mill-erection-service.html): Our oil mill erection service takes a plant from foundation to commissioning: civil guidance, machine installation and alignment, commissioning and operator training — plus re-erection, relocation, demolition and Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC). Projects run 2–10 weeks depending on plant size, anywhere in India.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What products does National Machinery Stores supply?
  A: We supply Mini Oil Expellers, High Capacity Oil Expellers, Screw Conveyors, Conveyor Belts, Casting Oil Filters, Plastic Oil Filters (Hydraulic), Vassal Oil Neutralizers, Radler Chains, Oil Expeller Spare Parts and complete Oil Mill Machinery. We also provide Oil Mill Erection, Demolition & Total Service Contracts, including AMC.
- Q: Do you supply both new and used oil expellers?
  A: Yes. We deal in both new and used (refurbished) oil expellers and oil mill machinery. We also work as commission agents: if you want to sell a used plant or machine, we connect you with buyers across India.
- Q: Which oil expeller size do I need?
  A: Size the expeller by daily seed input. A mini oil expeller handles 1–5 tonnes per day on 3–15 HP. A high capacity oil expeller handles 5–50+ tonnes per day on 20–75 HP and is built for continuous 24-hour running. Send your seed type and target tonnes per day on WhatsApp and we will recommend a model.
- Q: What is the difference between a plastic (hydraulic) oil filter and a casting oil filter?
  A: The plastic oil filter uses lightweight polypropylene plates closed hydraulically; it is about 50% lighter, corrosion-free, reasonably priced and the best choice for new oil mill plants. The casting oil filter is heavy-duty cast iron and more durable for high-volume operations. We help you choose for your setup and budget.
- Q: What is a Vassal Oil Neutralizer used for?
  A: A Vassal Oil Neutralizer is used in edible oil refining to neutralise free fatty acids (FFA) in crude oil with caustic soda, improving oil quality, colour and shelf life. It is the first step of the post-extraction refining stage, before bleaching and deodorisation.
- Q: What is a Radler Chain used for in an oil mill?
  A: A Radler (Redler) chain drives an en-masse conveyor that moves bulk material such as oilseeds, cake, flour and granules through an enclosed trough without breakage or segregation. In oil mills it feeds seed to expellers and carries cake and meal away.
- Q: Do you deliver outside Gujarat?
  A: Yes. We supply clients in 18+ Indian states, including Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Odisha, and export to Africa and other international markets. Every order includes GST billing and transit-safe packaging.
- Q: Can you handle complete oil plant installation?
  A: Yes. Our Oil Mill Erector, Demolition & Total Service Contract covers complete plant setup — civil guidance, machine installation, commissioning, operator training and ongoing Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC). Typical projects take 2–10 weeks depending on plant size.
- Q: How quickly are spare parts dispatched?
  A: Stocked spare parts are dispatched within 24–48 hours. We keep critical parts — worm shafts, barrels, cages and bearings — in stock to minimise mill downtime. For urgent needs, send a photo of the part on WhatsApp for the fastest response.
- Q: Where is National Machinery Stores located?
  A: Our office is at 12, Someshwar Complex, Nandasan Highway Road, Kadi, Mahesana – 382715, Gujarat. Our factory and warehouse is on Kadi Nandasan Road, opposite Ultratech RMC Plant, Survey No. 91, Kundal (Kadi), Mehsana – 382715. We are open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM IST.
- Q: Which languages does your sales team speak?
  A: Our sales team speaks Hindi, Gujarati and English. Call +91 94267 01635 or message us on WhatsApp at +91 88666 88626; we call back within 24–48 hours.
